event.description: Remove only the final LayerNorm additive bias
event.proposal: Family: normalization. Current retained frontier is 3,376 parameters at 99.180000%, a +0.180000 percentage-point margin over 99%. There are 0 prior attempts in this family, so no most recent accepted or failed in-family result exists. Attempt-0017 in token representation was a scored nonqualification at 0.02%, establishing that BOS participates materially and motivating a mechanism switch. Hypothesis: the final LayerNorm's learned scale is useful but its 16D additive bias is redundant before the tied bias-free output head; deleting only that bias and transplanting all remaining retained weights yields 3,360 parameters. This is parameterization-preserving normalization compression and is more informative than the nearest untested all-layer RMSNorm substitution because it isolates the smallest affine component before changing centering or four residual-block normalizers.
